page.overview:
Who is Linda Belcher?

Linda Belcher (née Genarro) is the devoted happy-go-lucky, wife of Bob Belcher and the mother of Tina, Gene, and Louise Belcher. She makes her first appearance in Season 25 episode "Homerland" during the closing credits.

During the closing credits in "Homerland," Linda, Bob, and her children were in the Simpson House celebrating the 25th season.

When Homer ends up entering Bob's Burgers after Marge pushed him into the door, Linda, Bob, and her children were watching him. Homer looks like being scared. When Louise said if Homer is about to rob in the restaurant, she feels sorry for him and said that makes fun of him to rob.

After the Simpson family escaped from the SimpsonsWorld resort, Linda serves them, which is surprising, telling them to turn off their headlights, informing them that the cheese has left out sweaty, and allows them to continue their discussion. Subsequently, she performs a song about cheese.
